item.title: Iran War Live Updates: Trump Mixes Diplomacy and Threats in Effort to Pressure Iran
item.summary: President Trump warned Iranian officials to consider his peace proposal “before it is too late.” Israel said that an airstrike had killed an Iranian naval commander overseeing the blockade of the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Australia Temporarily Blocks Iranians With Visitor Visas From Entry
item.summary: Iranian tourists with visas will be barred for six months in case they are ‘unable or unlikely’ to go back because of the war, Australian officials said.

item.title: Russian Lawmakers Go to U.S. for First Time Since Invasion of Ukraine
item.summary: The State Department had to lift sanctions on Russian lawmakers invited by a Kremlin-friendly member of Congress.

item.title: Trump’s Threats to Europe Put Its Leaders in a Double Bind Over Iran
item.summary: European politicians risk angering their voters if they join America’s war. Yet they could also face domestic upheaval if they take no action to reopen shipping routes that Iran has blocked and ease an energy crisis.

item.title: U.S. Military Kills 4 People in Boat Strike in Caribbean
item.summary: At least 163 people have been killed in the Trump administration’s campaign against suspected drug smuggling.

item.title: Who Is Alireza Tangsiri, the Latest Iranian Commander Targeted by Israel?
item.summary: Israel said it killed the naval commander, Alireza Tangsiri, in an airstrike on Thursday morning. Iran has not commented.

item.title: India Appears Sidelined as Pakistan Tries to Play Peacemaker in Iran
item.summary: Hours before a call between President Trump and India’s prime minister, American officials urged India to focus on shared goals and ignore differences.

item.title: In Rural Ukraine, Basic Health Care Is a Casualty of War
item.summary: Elderly people in isolated villages are going without medicine. One woman said she hadn’t seen a doctor in four years.

item.title: Two Killed in Abu Dhabi as Gulf States Face Fresh Attacks
item.summary: A Pakistani man and an Indian man died when shrapnel fell from an intercepted missile, officials said. Saudi Arabia, Kuwait and Bahrain also reported strikes.

item.title: The Sudden Death of a Man Who Told Chinese Kids How to Succeed
item.summary: The influencer Zhang Xuefeng was known for no-nonsense, some said cynical, advice about how to win in China’s educational rat race. He died at 41.
